# Nexa Horse Transport

> Horse transport company based in Cochrane, Alberta, Canada. Local and regional horse hauling across Alberta, a scheduled coast-to-coast route every two weeks (Langley, BC to Halifax, NS), and horse transport between Canada and the USA. A brand of Nexa Line Ltd., an Alberta corporation.

- Phone: 1-844-491-6392 (toll-free)
- Email: info@nexahorsetransport.ca
- Equipment: 2026 Ford F-350 dually with a Four Star 6+1 straight-load gooseneck horse trailer; standard, roomier and box stalls
- Pricing: Canadian dollars, per horse, per kilometre from Canada, plus GST; $300 minimum per trip; vet, border, government and customs broker fees at cost; no booking fees. Online estimates are confirmed by phone or email.
- Home base: Cochrane, Alberta (just west of Calgary).
- Care on the road: regular rest stops with hay and fresh water around the clock; no grain on the road; owners send enough bales of hay for the whole trip; at least 2 hours' notice before pickup and before delivery, and daily updates along the way.
- Payment and cancellation: no deposit; full payment due at least 24 hours before the estimated delivery time; free cancellation any time before the horse is loaded. Nexa never holds a horse for payment.
- What to send: a properly fitted flat halter (no rope halters) and lead rope, enough hay for the whole trip; one small tote or box, one saddle and one blanket travel free with each horse.
- Insurance: Nexa does not insure horses; owners are encouraged to carry equine mortality and medical insurance.
- Trips with both ends in Canada stay on Canadian highways.
- USA: cross-border trips only (every US trip starts or ends in Canada). Border crossings used: Kingsgate – Eastport (BC), Coutts – Sweetgrass (AB), North Portal (SK), Emerson (MB), Sarnia – Port Huron, Windsor – Detroit, Niagara Falls – Lewiston, Thousand Islands Bridge at Lansdowne, ON – Alexandria Bay, NY (Highway 137 / Interstate 81), Lacolle – Champlain (QC), Woodstock – Houlton (NB).
- Scheduled route, every two weeks in both directions: Langley – Kamloops – Calgary – Edmonton – Saskatoon – Regina – Winnipeg – Thunder Bay – Sudbury – Toronto – Ottawa – Montréal – Québec City – Fredericton – Moncton – Halifax, with Charlottetown, PEI via the Confederation Bridge.

## Horse communities served

- British Columbia: Langley (Campbell Valley, Brookswood, Milner Downs, Thunderbird Show Park), Aldergrove, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Kamloops and Knutsford, Kelowna, Vernon, Armstrong, Salmon Arm, Cranbrook, Sparwood, Williams Lake, Prince George.
- Alberta: Calgary and Foothills County (De Winton, Okotoks, Priddis, Millarville), Cochrane, Bragg Creek and Rocky View County, Airdrie, Red Deer, Innisfail, Edmonton area, Olds, Carstairs, Sundre, Caroline, Ponoka, Rimbey, Strathmore, High River, Nanton, Claresholm, Lethbridge, Grande Prairie, Lloydminster, Barrhead, Stettler, Camrose.
- Saskatchewan: Saskatoon and Corman Park, Regina area, Moose Jaw, Swift Current, Maple Creek, North Battleford, Prince Albert, Lloydminster, Yorkton, Melville, Weyburn, Estevan, Melfort, Tisdale, Kindersley.
- Manitoba: Winnipeg and Birds Hill, Headingley, Brandon and Westman, Selkirk, Stonewall, Steinbach, Morris, Niverville, Portage la Prairie, Morden, Winkler, Virden, Dauphin, Neepawa, the Interlake.
- Ontario: London, Strathroy, Brantford, Paris, Niagara Region, Campbellville, Milton, Guelph, Erin, Caledon, King Township, Newmarket, Uxbridge, Port Perry, Barrie, Kingston, Ottawa Valley.
- Québec: Saint-Lazare, Hudson, Rigaud, Gatineau, Blainville, Mirabel, Lachute, Terrebonne, Joliette, Bromont, Sutton, Saint-Hyacinthe, Granby, Sherbrooke, Drummondville, Trois-Rivières, Québec City, Lévis.
- New Brunswick: Woodstock, Fredericton, Keswick Ridge, Saint John, Quispamsis, Hampton, Sussex, Moncton, Sackville.
- Nova Scotia: Amherst, Truro, Enfield, Greater Halifax, Windsor, Wolfville, Kentville, Bridgewater, New Glasgow.
- Prince Edward Island: Charlottetown and area.
